newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran reports problems with Caspian oil drilling.
newsitem.headline: Iran reports problems with Caspian oil drilling.

text.p: Iran said on Wednesday it had temporarily halted drilling its first oil well in the Caspian Sea after operations ran into problems, the Iranian news agency IRNA said.

It quoted Mehdi Husseini, exploration director for the National Iranian Oil Company, as saying "the presence of water below the Caspian sea bed...is the main reason for the temporary halt to (the) drilling operation".

"In view of the fact that everything in the sea is unknown and unexpected problems particulary in relation to controlling water pressure may arise, a temporary halt of operation is quite natural," he said.
Husseini denied an Azeri media report that Iran had stopped drilling the well, its first in the Caspian Sea, after reaching a depth of 5,767 metres, IRNA said.
He said work was progressing normally and drilling would continue to 6,000 metres and deeper "if technically possible".
